description:
## Why

Per parent PKIX-77cl design §6 and §8: PKITS §4.5 must split across two crates because the 4 FAIL cases fail on revocation, and pkix-path is no_std without revocation.

## Scope (this PR only)

Add `pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs` containing the 4 §4.5 PASS cases:
- 4.5.1 Valid Basic Self-Issued Old With New Test1
- 4.5.3 Valid Basic Self-Issued New With Old Test3
- 4.5.4 Valid Basic Self-Issued New With Old Test4
- 4.5.6 Valid Basic Self-Issued CRL Signing Key Test6

These exercise RFC 5280 §6.1.4(h) (policy/inhibit counter skip on self-issued) and §6.1.4(m) (pathLen counts only NON-self-issued certs). They are the regression-protective baseline for chain_walk refactor (PKIX-als9 H7, H10, H11).

## Out of scope

The 4 FAIL cases (4.5.2, 4.5.5, 4.5.7, 4.5.8) — they fail on revocation, belong in PR-2 (pkix-revocation). Including them in pkix-path tests would have them wrongly pass.

## Implementation

- Reuse existing `pkix-path/tests/pkits_helper.rs` — no new helpers.
- Pattern: copy boilerplate from `pkits_4_6_4_7.rs`.
- Per-test rustdoc: PKITS source line + RFC 5280 site + 'MUST validate'.
- Chain ordering (leaf-first, anchor excluded) per parent bead design §6.
- Oracle: PKITS vectors.json (ShouldValidate=true).

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs` exists with 4 PASS tests.
- [ ] All 4 tests pass: `cargo test -p pkix-path --test pkits_4_5`.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` clean.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-features -p pkix-path -- -D warnings` clean.
- [ ] No new dependencies added.
notes: Committed as 5baa23c0. 4 PASS tests added in pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs. Key finding documented inline: §4.5.4 Test4EE and §4.5.6 Test6EE chain directly to the main CA (verified via AKI), not through the self-issued bridge — the PKITS canonical CertPath assumes a path builder, while pkix-path is positional. cargo fmt + clippy + test all clean. Full pkix-path suite (87 tests) passes.
title: PR-1: pkix-path PKITS §4.5 PASS subset (4.5.1, 4.5.3, 4.5.4, 4.5.6)
